The Abandoned {{tt|Megacheap|Mega Mart}}!'') is the 16th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Faba]] and [[Wicke]] give {{adv|Moon}}, [[Professor Kukui]], and [[Professor Burnet]] a tour of [[Aether Paradise]]. * After hearing the [[Trial Captain]]s are going to meet with [[Team Skull]], Faba heads off to inform [[Lusamine]]. * [[Acerola]] properly introduces herself to {{adv|Sun}} and [[Lillie]]. * Acerola tells Sun that if he wants to meet with {{p|Tapu Bulu}}, he'll need to complete her [[island challenge|trial]] first. * Sun is given the task of photographing the {{pkmn2|Totem}} Pokémon that lives inside of the abandoned {{OBP|Thrifty Megamart|Abandoned Site}} and gives him a camera to complete the task. * After finding the Totem, a {{p|Mimikyu}}, Sun battles against it, but the camera ends up getting destroyed. * [[Rotom Pokédex (Adventures)|Rotom]] reveals that it got dragged along when Sun went to rescue Lillie earlier and lets Sun use its Poké Finder function to replace the broken camera. * At the {{al|Trainers' School}}, [[Ilima]] agrees to help [[Mallow]] and the others meet with Team Skull. * [[Hau]] appears at the Trainers' School to meet with Ilima and is revealed to have obtained a {{p|Popplio}}. * [[Sina]] and [[Dexio]] arrive on [[Ula'ula Island]] to find someone that can help with their search for {{adv|Zygarde}}'s {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Cores and Cells}} scattered across [[Alola]].
